high_level_description: The image captures a model walking down the runway during Versace's Spring-Summer 2026 show at Milan Fashion Week. The model, identified as Alex Consani, is wearing an intricately designed, embellished bralette with a mix of metallic and gemstone-like accents. The top is adorned with a pattern that includes gold and silver tones, giving it a luxurious and eye-catching appearance. The setting appears to be an elegant indoor venue, likely a grand hall or ballroom, characterized by ornate architectural details such as a large, intricately carved wooden door on the right side of the image.
